findings: Our four wins had 40-21 shots overall; the single loss to Feyenoord had 8-4 shots for us but 1-2 on target. The sample supports a recurring finishing/shot-quality question, not a causal conclusion.
The four wins came with a combined low 43.4% mean possession. Against Le Masia, 30% possession coincided with 8-0 shots; possession alone is not a useful quality proxy in this sample.

Opponent reports are consistently CLEAR-heavy (weighted 86% of 250 reported commands), while live commentary often described pressing or patient buildup. Commentary is not a verified action policy; test pressure-breaking and forward passing against actual match reports rather than assuming labels.

Own latency is unstable: four reports were 82-847ms while Tajfun report shows 15941ms despite zero own commands and 11-19s role latency. The cause is unknown. The <=10ms target was not met in any match; opponent team averages were 15-25ms.
All role success figures shown were 100%, but the reports do not supply independent request timeouts or runtime-health evidence. Do not infer reliability solely from these values.
